question.prompt: 5 light bulbs are randomly selected from a batch, and their measured lifespans (in hours) are 1000, 1020, 980, 1010, and 990. Estimate the mean lifespan of this batch of light bulbs. (Unit: hours. Enter only the number.)

solutions.explanation: The sample mean is \((1000+1020+980+1010+990)\div5=5000\div5=1000\). Use it to estimate the population's mean lifespan.
solutions.title: Use the sample mean
